name: Penpie Pendle-market reward reentrancy
summary: PendleStaking's batchHarvestMarketRewards() harvested rewards from a permissionlessly registered Pendle market without a shared reentrancy guard or a trusted-market boundary. The attacker registered a market backed by an attacker-controlled SY token, then re-entered depositMarket() during the harvest callback so pre-deposit reward accounting credited its position with the real markets' pending rewards; it then withdrew Penpie's staked Pendle LP as if it were the attacker's reward entitlement.

loss.notes: Ethereum-only gross victim depletion, measured from the three successful drain receipts (0x56e09abb, 0x42b2ec27, 0x663b55a1). Each drain is an atomic flash-borrow: the attacker contract borrows the SY-underlying from Balancer, mints Pendle LP, deposits it into PendleStaking, re-enters to double-count its LP entitlement, withdraws twice the deposited LP (its own plus an equal amount of Penpie's staked inventory), redeems all of it, and repays the flash loan. The flash loans and the attacker's own LP net to zero within each receipt, so the attack contract's net positive token balance at the end of each drain equals the value extracted from Penpie. Summed across the three drains the attacker contracts (0x4af4c234, 0x4476b6ca, 0xcde2cd6a) netted the SY-underlying: 2722.896986125761481022 wstETH, 2522685.569779116882495579 sUSDe, 4100.512911329222524018 agETH and 2695.125694968916318170 rswETH; the four Pendle markets drained were the wstETH, sUSDe, agETH and rswETH pools (PENDLE-LPT tokens 0xc374f7ec, 0xd1d7d997, 0x6010676b, 0x038c1b03) whose net outflow from proxy 0x6e799758 reconciles with these redemptions. The USD total 27,311,618 values only those four liquid SY-underlying assets at DefiLlama incident prices (wstETH, sUSDe and rswETH direct-token series). agETH has no DefiLlama series with a pre-loss observation, so it is valued at the WETH incident price 2446.82956672678 (source-11, observed 1725387742, before the anchor) times agETH's on-chain convertToAssets rate 0.999221757635697525, i.e. 2444.925340299725; DefiLlama's kelp-gain series (nearest observation 2450.63 at 1725409884, about six hours later) confirms this to within 0.2 percent. The attacker also kept the paired yield tokens (YT-stETH, YT-sUSDE, YT-agETH, YT-rswETH) whose exact quantities are recorded with null USD because they are decaying, thinly traded and lack a clean price series; they are additional extraction, so the measured figure is a slight lower bound. Confidence is medium because agETH and rswETH are large restaked-ETH quantities spot-marked rather than measured at the attacker's realised disposal, and the yield-token leg is unpriced. Zokyo reports about $27M and CUBE3 about $28M for the combined Ethereum and Arbitrum campaign; the Ethereum leg measured here is essentially that headline, and the separate Arbitrum record (eip155:42161:0x67c5400d...) holds the Arbitrum loss so nothing is double-counted. Later Penpie recovery negotiations are not netted.

ageReset.description: The final pre-incident Upgraded(address) event reselected PendleStaking implementation 0xff51c6b493c1e4df4e491865352353eadff0f9f8 (11th and last Upgraded event before the incident).

sources.note: Reviewed the four reported campaign transactions and their successful receipts, the first Ethereum drain's call trace, the proxy and implementation creation transactions, the proxy's verified OpenZeppelin architecture, every Upgraded(address) event from deployment through the incident, implementation-slot values, historical runtime bytecode, the commit-pinned reproduction, and independent technical loss reports. The first drain is transaction index 0 of Ethereum block 20671820. Its trace repeatedly calls PendleStaking proxy 0x6e799758cee75dae3d84e09d40dc416ecf713652 and delegates the affected functions to 0xff51c6b493c1e4df4e491865352353eadff0f9f8. Exactly 11 Upgraded events precede the incident; the final event is log 45 of transaction 0x166b56c5feb64f9da0dcbef7ad8a95af65ff0a8e2635f38ee3d3ee6d0970e2d4 and selects that artifact. Its 22,956-byte runtime hashes to 0xfadd1391fb10f9450ef4d67e74b2a7ae7deda058d36a548462c2f835ce9b9da4 at activation and immediately before the incident. Three successful Ethereum drains and one successful Arbitrum drain form the reported cross-chain campaign.

Re-verified the record and reworked the loss to an Ethereum-only, receipt-measured basis. Anchor: 0x56e09abb is transaction index 0 of block 20671820 (timestamp 1725387815) and is the earliest of the three successful Ethereum drains (the others are 0x42b2ec27 at 18:37:59 and 0x663b55a1 at 18:42:35); it is nonce 0 of attacker EOA 0xc0eb7e6e, funded by 0x7a2f4d62. Scanning both attacker EOAs' full Ethereum nonce history, no earlier successful transaction executes the reentrancy: prior activity is market-registration and setup calls (selectors 0x46a40b1c and 0x87a9ec40) that do not trigger batchHarvestMarketRewards. Target identity: the impl slot 0x360894...382bbc of proxy 0x6e799758 reads 0xff51c6b493c1e4df4e491865352353eadff0f9f8 at incident block 20671820, whose runtime hashes to 0xfadd1391fb10f9450ef4d67e74b2a7ae7deda058d36a548462c2f835ce9b9da4; the last Upgraded event before the incident (block 20075092, tx 0x166b56c5, log 45, ts 1718187383) selected that same implementation, giving code age 7200432 s. The attacker-registered market and its SY token are attack machinery (explicit attribution in the summary), never a target or age basis. Loss: traced every ERC20 Transfer in the three drain receipts. Each drain flash-borrows the SY-underlying from Balancer (0xba1222...), mints Pendle LP, deposits it into the proxy, re-enters depositMarket during harvest to double-count, withdraws 2x the deposited LP (own plus an equal slice of Penpie's inventory), redeems it and repays the flash loan; flash loans and the attacker's own LP net to zero, so the attack contracts' end-of-tx net positive balances are the extraction. Verified for the agETH market in drain 1: 1387.14 agETH borrowed and repaid, 833.85 agETH-LP redeemed (2x the 416.93 deposited, the extra 416.93 matching proxy 0x6e799758's net agETH-LP outflow), net +1373.13 agETH. Summed across drains: 2722.896986125761481022 wstETH, 2522685.569779116882495579 sUSDe, 4100.512911329222524018 agETH, 2695.125694968916318170 rswETH, plus the paired yield tokens recorded with null USD. USD 27,311,618 uses DefiLlama incident prices; agETH (which has no pre-loss DefiLlama observation) is valued at the WETH incident price times its on-chain convertToAssets rate 0.999221757635697525, cross-checked against the later kelp-gain series to within 0.2 percent. This matches Zokyo's ~$27M and CUBE3's ~$28M cross-chain headlines, confirming the Ethereum leg is essentially the reported figure; the Arbitrum gUSDC leg is recorded separately and not duplicated here.

limitations: The USD total values only the four liquid SY-underlying assets (wstETH, sUSDe, agETH, rswETH) at DefiLlama incident prices; the paired yield tokens the attacker also kept are recorded with exact quantities but null USD, so the measured figure is a slight lower bound. agETH and rswETH are large restaked-ETH quantities spot-marked rather than measured at the attacker's realised disposal.
